title: This PR contains the intended content for the 27.6 release of ubuntu-advantage-tools.
description:
This PR contains the intended content for the 27.6 release of ubuntu-advantage-tools.
The release is better described in this SRU bug:
https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/ubuntu-advantage-tools/+bug/1958556

Additionally, we have also already uploaded this package into our staging ppa:
https://launchpad.net/~ua-client/+archive/ubuntu/staging/

Let us know if there is anything that need to be addressed in this release
